description: Search public Home Affairs visa condition descriptions by number or keyword, or omit keyword to browse. Results are grouped by condition number; get_visa_condition returns all source records. English is official source text; Chinese is translated. Does not determine conditions attached to a personal visa. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

name: search_visa_conditions
title: Search Australian visa conditions
